arrival_compliance_rate.basis: Share of eligible travelers assumed to change arrival time; no observed host-city compliance study is supplied.

arrival_eligible_share.basis: Share of peak arrivals assumed reachable and eligible for timed communications or curb controls; no FIFA response observations are supplied.

arrival_management_cost_per_pct.basis: Event communications, curb allocation, staffing, and enforcement screening allowance.

arrival_shoulder_capacity_share.basis: Maximum peak-equivalent demand that shoulder periods are assumed able to absorb without a local curb or holding-capacity study.

bike_hub_cost_per_space.basis: Order-of-magnitude installed secure parking and event operations allowance.

bike_hub_reuse_events.basis: Planning event uses over which reusable bike-hub capital is allocated for comparison; total project cost remains visible.

bike_hub_turnover.basis: Completed event trips per installed bike or micromobility parking space.

bike_max_distance_m.basis: Maximum practical active-mode distance sensitivity; the model currently uses the base threshold.

bike_uptake_share.basis: Distance-limited active-mode uptake ceiling; not observed fan behavior.

cooled_walkway_cost_per_km.basis: Conceptual corridor allowance combining crossings, shade, cooling, and design contingency.

cooled_walkway_reuse_events.basis: Planning event uses over which reusable walking-corridor capital is allocated for comparison; total project cost remains visible.

heat_exposure_hours_per_walker.basis: Walking exposure-duration sensitivity for treated venue approaches.

maximum_new_walk_share.basis: Upper bound on incremental walking uptake in the screening model.

park_ride_cost_per_space.basis: Conceptual temporary/permanent remote-parking allowance; local scope is required.

park_ride_occupancy.basis: Vehicle occupancy sensitivity for event park-and-ride users.

park_ride_reuse_events.basis: Planning event uses over which reusable park-and-ride capital is allocated for comparison; total project cost remains visible.

park_ride_utilization.basis: Share of provided remote spaces assumed occupied.

private_vehicle_co2e_kg_per_mile.basis: EPA national typical gasoline vehicle is the base; bounds are planning sensitivity values.

route_heat_reduction_c.basis: Screening response for shade/cooling treatment; replace with a designed corridor study.

service_load_factor.basis: Share of nominal vehicle capacity assumed usable during event operations.

service_vehicle_co2e_kg_per_mile.basis: EPA diesel CO2 factor divided by 8/6/4 mpg sensitivity assumptions; upstream emissions excluded.

shuttle_cost_per_bus_hour.basis: Order-of-magnitude bus operating range informed by NTD operating-expense categories.

shuttle_passengers_per_bus.basis: Event shuttle seated/standing capacity sensitivity; verify against procured fleet.

transit_cost_per_departure.basis: Two-point-two vehicle-hours per added departure multiplied by the bus-hour planning range.

transit_passengers_per_departure.basis: Cross-mode planning capacity for added departures; scheduled capacity is not observed loading.

walk_uptake_per_covered_km.basis: Incremental walking uptake sensitivity per covered corridor kilometer.

policy.currency: Values are not automatically escalated; registry version must state the planning year
policy.use: Planning sensitivity only; not engineering estimates or a local emissions inventory
